name: Figma Make
tagline: Figma Make is Figma's AI-driven prompt-to-app tool for turning a prompt or existing Figma designs into functional prototypes, interactive UI, and web apps. It combines AI chat with a visual canvas and code editor, so teams can iterate on generated experiences while retaining their design-system context.
